artworks.title: Bridal Pair
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This drawing features a scene with a skeleton, a man, and a woman, all dressed in historical clothing. The skeleton holds a musical instrument and interacts with the couple. In the background, there are two figures resembling angels or allegorical statues with symbols like an hourglass and a scythe. An inscription in Latin reads "Me & te sola mors separabit." Architectural elements such as columns and draped fabric frame the scene. A second skeleton is depicted at the bottom of the image. The drawing demonstrates detailed linework typical of engravings.

artworks.title: Bride
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a skeleton, two women, and various symbolic elements. The scene is set within an ornate frame with classical architectural elements and decorative figures, such as cherubs and skulls. The skeleton gestures towards one of the women, while the two women exchange a glance. The drawing captures rich textures in the clothing and architectural elements, with expressions and gestures suggesting themes of mortality and time. Latin text at the bottom of the image enhances the allegorical nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Merchant
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a maritime setting and various classical allegorical elements. The central panel depicts ships at sea, while the foreground shows figures appearing to be in distress, surrounded by sacks and barrels. The border of the image features classical elements, cherubic figures, emblems like skulls, crossbones, and hourglasses. The sides of the image show columns with figures holding containers. Latin text is included in the image.

artworks.title: Peddler
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton assisting a man burdened with various items, within an ornate architectural frame featuring classical columns and figures. The skeleton is guiding the man, who carries his burdens on his back and is accompanied by a goat. The drawing includes a Latin inscription translating to "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened." The style of the drawing may be influenced by esoteric and allegorical themes.

artworks.title: Miser
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is an image of an allegorical scene. In the center, a richly dressed figure gestures towards a skeleton holding a book or ledger. They are in a vaulted room with an arched window and a candle on the table. The table has coins and valuables, with a treasure chest underneath. Pillars and statuesque figures frame the scene. Above, cherubs and a skull are depicted. Below, cherubic figures accompany symbols of mortality like skulls and an hourglass. The drawing uses strong lines and shadows for depth and drama.

artworks.title: Waggoner
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a skeleton on an overturned cart with barrels, a fallen horse, and various figures within an intricate architectural border.

artworks.title: Gamesters
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people around a table. Five figures are sitting around a table scattered with playing cards or notes, dice, and coins. In the upper part of the drawing, skeletal and demonic figures emerge from a window, creating an ominous presence over the seated individuals. The architecture surrounding them is ornate, with two figures akin to statues flanking the scene. Below them sit cherub-like figures, one holding an hourglass. Above the main window display, a skull is centrally placed between two reclining cherubs on an additional architectural element.

artworks.title: Old Man
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a memento mori scene. The central panel shows a skeletal figure with a scythe and an older bearded man with a walking stick. Behind them are clouds and a tree. The scene is framed by architectural elements with columns and figures holding various objects. Below the main image are more skeletal remains. Latin text is inscribed beneath the main image.

artworks.title: Old Woman
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a print depicting several skeletons in a macabre scene. In the center is a rectangular image showing two skeletons standing near an old, hunched woman. One of the skeletons is wearing a crown of leafy branches, and the other appears to be playing a xylophone that hangs around its bony neck. The woman is facing the right, wearing a long cloak and holding a walking stick. On the ground in front of her is an hourglass. The landscape around the woman and skeletons is rocky, with tall plants on the left and distant mountains on the right under a wide, cloudy sky. Below this central image is a line of text. The text and image are bordered by a light frame, which is surrounded by candles and statues. On the left and right are two sculpted figures, one holding an hourglass and a scythe, and the other holding a thin ring, which upon closer inspection is revealed to be a serpent biting its tail. Above the central image are drapery and candlesticks, as well as large vases holding flowers. At the bottom of the print, below the line of text, is another skeletal figure laying on the ground, a shovel and hoe laying by its legs. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Child
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with classical architecture and skeletons. In the central part, there is a scene framed by wooden beams. Skeletal figures are on either side, one gesturing towards the central figure. Symbols of mortality such as an hourglass, a scythe, and skeletons are present. The drawing is detailed with columns, floral arrangements, candle holders, and a Latin inscription. The bottom section shows more skeletal imagery in a memento mori theme, similar to Hans Holbein's style.

artworks.title: Death's Coat of Arms
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a scene framed by intricate architecture. In the center, a man and a woman face each other, both standing upright. The man on the left wears a robe and a plumed hat, while the woman on the right wears elaborate clothing and a decorative hairstyle. Between them is a large cloth with a skull and hourglass motif, which they both touch. Male figures on pedestals flank them. At the top are two reclining cherubs, and at the bottom, two seated cherubs each holding an hourglass, with skulls between them. The background shows classical architecture with columns and floral elements.

artworks.title: Katharine Furlegerin
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's upper body, focusing on her head, shoulders, and hands. She has her eyes closed and hands clasped in front of her. Her face appears calm with smooth skin and a soft expression. She has long, curly hair with a braid wrapped around her head. She is wearing a simple garment with a high neckline, and the background is a textured surface with subtle patterns. No jewelry or objects are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a scene divided into two sections. In the upper section, figures dressed in period clothing surround a large decorative scroll inscribed with Latin text. The lower section shows a landscape labeled "Praga," depicting a historical view of Prague with a detailed cityscape, trees, and a structure in the foreground, extending into the distance. The engraving predominantly uses a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Near Prague
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated perspective. The horizon is about a third from the top of the composition, where land and sky meet. To the right, there are hills sketched with fine lines, showing a terraced arrangement of fields. Closest to us are farmland, vegetation rows, and clusters of trees. In the distance, across a river, a faint structure, possibly a church spire, stands out on the horizon. The sky has sparse, soft clouds, and the monochromatic palette uses varying line densities for depth and lighting. The scene exudes tranquility, emphasizing the natural beauty of the rural landscape.

artworks.title: Prague
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a view overlooking a calm body of water and the city of Prague. The horizon is positioned about two-thirds up the piece, with an intricate cityscape with dense foliage and various structures, including towers and buildings labeled 'Das Schloß.' A hillside labeled 'S. Lorentzberg' is on the left, featuring a lightly sketched pattern representing vegetation or fields. The sky above has swirling clouds with delicate, horizontal hatching lines for texture. Closest to the viewer, a river or lake stretches across the composition with a few small boats visible, including one with passengers. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black against off-white paper, creating a classic and serene visual impact.

artworks.title: Nuremberg
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape of Nuremberg from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The view displays a series of arching bridges leading to densely packed buildings and distant church spires. The artwork is created in an etching style with fine, detailed lines. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black ink on light cream-colored paper. A river is visible in the foreground, bordered by wooden structures and small figures. The medieval-style buildings with steep roofs are prominent throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Augsburg
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape dominated by a circular embankment with a row of buildings, city walls, and a church labeled "S. Ulrich" on the horizon. The cityscape is nestled behind a grassy mound with bushes. The illustration features precise black linework for the hillside and buildings, with various hatching and stippling techniques used for clouds and skies. The color palette includes shades of cream and black, typical of a monochromatic etching. Figures in period attire walk along a path circling the embankment, adding scale. In the distance, the cityscape with steeples and towers merges with the sky filled with stylized cumulus clouds.

artworks.title: On the Neckar
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two figures wearing hats and long garments. The horizon features a rugged hill labeled "Wurttemberg" with a castle or fort on top. The style resembles detailed linework, giving texture to the figures and land. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and gray on a beige background. In the distance, there are rolling hills and cloudy skies.

artworks.title: Strasbourg: The Toll House
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a fortified structure near a body of water. The horizon is low in the composition, with the building and a plume of smoke drawing the eye. The style is detailed line etching with a monochromatic color palette of black on a cream background. A small boat is visible, and distant structures are depicted with finer lines.

artworks.title: Strasbourg: The Toll House
artworks.description: The image depicts a scenic view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned above the center, with a line of trees and small distant figures along a river creating a division between land and sky. Small boats can be seen among the trees on the water. The illustration features precise and delicate linear brushstrokes, providing texture to the landscape and the sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray with lighter areas for contrast. The terrain is intricately detailed with ridges and small lines suggesting grass or brush. The clouds are depicted with swirling linear strokes, adding elegance to the scene.

artworks.title: Strasbourg
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a tower labeled "Brußeck", surrounded by buildings, trees, and another structure labeled "Hohen Waert" in the distance. The style is detailed and fine, typical of etching techniques, outlining the textures of the buildings, trees, and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic with black and gray tones. Closer to the viewer, there are detailed fields with visible furrows, and lines show texture and shading in the distant landscape. The sky has horizontal hatchings suggesting clouding or a gradient effect.

artworks.title: Strasbourg
artworks.description: The image shows a townscape with buildings like a church labeled "S. Thomas." The scene is depicted in an etching style with detailed lines, featuring clouds in the sky. In the foreground, there are figures on cobblestones, with more buildings and a boat in the background under a sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Speyer
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape of Speyer from a slightly elevated viewpoint. Speyer Cathedral, "Der Thumb," is visible on the horizon with its towers. The artwork features detailed linework and shading. Ships with tall masts are seen on the left, near a small structure, possibly a crane or windlass. Figures and horse-drawn carts are present, with the river curving towards the city in the distance. A large tree is depicted on the right side. The color scheme is primarily black ink on paper, creating a classic impression. The composition is balanced, with architectural structures in the distance contrasting with the natural elements in the foreground.

artworks.title: Hanau
artworks.description: The image displays a hand-drawn pastoral landscape. The composition features a horizon line in the upper third with a distant village labeled "Steinheim." The landscape is detailed with horizontal brushstrokes and cross-hatching, resembling engraving or pen and ink. Fields with lines suggesting plow tracks or planting rows are depicted in the foreground, leading to clusters of trees and the horizon. The sky is filled with swirling cloud patterns, adding depth. The image is monochrome, using shades of grey and black for contrast.
